summary: Floriana is confirmed at 1602 17th Street NW in Dupont Circle. The complete current dinner and Sunday brunch menus contain 48 unique food/nonalcoholic products; all 40 frozen rows remain current and reconcile exactly, with shared dinner/brunch dishes consolidated. No formal allergen matrix or cross-contact statement was found after all four required searches, so only direct ingredient positives are retained and all other item-level allergen data is unavailable.
